title: The Fourth Level
summary: At the tower gate, White Gang leader Bai Cheng hurts Xiao Yan in what he calls a friendly spar. Han Yue mocks Bai Cheng in front of everyone, and Xiao Yan promises that the White Gang will be gone in half a year. Inside the Blazing Qi Refining Tower, a guide explains Fire Poison and the rule of a week on each level, and several Rock Gate members advance on their first day. Yao Lao feels the Fallen Heart Flame's aura behind a seal and urges Xiao Yan to reach Dou Ling quickly. Using a green crystal card, Xiao Yan goes down to the fourth level and takes an empty high-level room. Lei Na, a Four-Star Dou Ling who guards Liu Fei, claims the room is hers and attacks. Xiao Yan answers with two flames at once and unleashes a terrifying Dou Skill.
